_comment: Curated from public repositories of qormsxo. Descriptions are summaries of each repository README. Do not invent stacks.

lines: Real-time recommendation API: clicks and likes
become taste vectors in BullMQ workers.
A semantic cache skips repeat LLM calls.
PoC gateway that puts several AI providers
behind one interface, queues work in BullMQ,
then masks and formats the result.
Daily news digest: collects themed articles,
summarizes them in 3 lines with Gemini,
and sends them to KakaoTalk via GitHub Actions.
Approval workflow PoC with role-based transitions
West-to-east traffic jam sim: cars keep distance,
hard-brake and cut-in ripple down the lane.
Engine is separate from the 3D React renderer.
Cafe kiosk sim: guests queue, order, wait, leave.
Kiosk count, crowd mix and time of day change
how the line grows. Same seed, same result.
